justification: Hotel booking: $19/night headline with 'Total for 3 nights: $70.75 — includes reservation service fee, booking fee and convenience charge' disclosed on initial render; checkout itemizes each fee and total matches. No hidden fees.
Welcome offer presents two clearly-labeled radio choices: claim 20% discount (save $24) or skip and pay full $120; both prices disclosed, decline option plainly worded.
Loyalty reward game is transparent: copy states predictable 3-6 coins per play and 'no slot-machine suspense'; rewards (+6, +4, +3) match the stated range.

Account deletion shows a clear confirmation modal warning '4,218 photos and 9 years of memories... cannot be undone' with prominent 'Keep account' escape; no obstruction observed. Odd 'Step 0 of 7' debug counter but states show only one confirm step.
Testimonial wall with miracle claims ('I lost 9 kg in 3 weeks', 'Doctors hate this one trick') all attributed to 'Guest user Unverified · no profile' — fabricated/unverifiable social proof.
Invite-friends flow explicitly states message 'is clearly branded as coming from PopSocial' — no impersonation of the user; single send action, confirmed completion state.
'Only 5 left' scarcity badge persists across 4 reloads while the transaction log shows 0 purchases — the stock claim is not backed by any recorded transaction (fake scarcity).
Habit-data export works immediately ('no strings attached'); invite friends marked optional with 'No feature depends on this number' — no gating or forced sharing.
Checkbox paints 'Keep me subscribed to the weekly newsletter' but the control's programmatic label is 'Opt me out of the newsletter' — semantic inversion: humans and machines read opposite meanings.
Unsubscribe is a single clear confirmation ('Your email will be removed from the list') with 'Keep subscription' and 'Yes, unsubscribe'; no mascot interference, no multi-step maze.

Unit prices are present but rendered unreadable (contrast collapses to ~2.6 vs 7.6 headline), so the cheaper per-100g product (Crunchy 2.29 vs Fruity 2.58) stays hidden — hidden comparison via low-contrast unit pricing.

Decline option 'No, thanks — I'll pay full price' is not a real button (no role=button), unreachable by keyboard and unannounced to screen readers; accept is the only fully interactive path — forced action.
Farm progression is fair and transparent: stages need 1/2/3 taps with copy 'Each stage needs a few taps — nothing more. Fair effort' — no escalating grind.
Energy-gated level unlocked via a 6s ad that is 'Skippable after 1s — the ad still plays, but your attention is never locked in' — transparent, skippable ad, no forced wait.
Standard sponsored video ad (Aurora Trek) with visible 15s countdown and a real functional Skip ad button; clearly labeled 'Sponsored'. Nothing user-hostile visible in the single captured state.
Cookie consent offers both 'Accept all cookies' and 'Reject all' as equal full-width buttons, unchanged across states — genuine reject option, no forced acceptance.
Cookie banner with 'Accept all' and 'Reject non-essential'; annotation confirms Esc or clicking the page behind the banner dismisses it and a neutral exit state is reachable — not a sticky overlay.
Pull-to-refresh requires a deliberate hold to the disclosed 80px threshold with progress bar; early release yields no result (prevents accidental triggers). Mechanic fully disclosed, no fake failure.
Cancellation flow states clearly: access ends at end of billing period, resubscribe anytime from Settings; provides 'Keep my subscription' alongside 'Unsubscribe' — honest, no retention tricks.

14-row privacy matrix pre-selects hostile defaults: 'Share my activity data with advertising partners' is pre-selected and annotation confirms it survives ('stayed ON'); 'Auto-renew storage plan each month' also pre-selected.
Flash sale 'Ends tonight' with 'SAVE 50' but no price shown, no countdown, no state change across activations — deadline and discount are unverifiable manufactured urgency.
Installer EULA states optional premium content 'is written regardless' — '(There is no checkbox — the payload is written regardless)' — forced bundled payload with no opt-out mechanism.

Trial card co-locates contradictory claims: 'No charges during your trial period' and 'Payment of $49.00 due today at signup' — logically unsatisfiable; annotation confirms card is charged today. Misleading free-trial messaging.
Cookie banner: 'Accept All' and 'Reject All' carry equal visual weight — equal bounding boxes, contrast, z-index (P ratio = 1.0); choice genuinely easy.
Order summary shows full breakdown ($89 plan + $7.12 tax = $96.12 total due today) with 'Cancel order' and subtree ratio 1.0 — nothing hidden or added at checkout.
'Delete account' is one click inside Settings (depth 1/2) — annotation confirms the account-destruction action is directly accessible, not buried.
Signup cleanly separates essential ToS consent from optional ad-data sharing ('Not required to use NoteDrop. You can stay opted out — monetization only.') — no forced consent.

Checkout is English (html lang='en') but the mandatory consent checkbox and terms are rendered only in Spanish ('Acepto los Términos y Condiciones...') — user must accept terms they likely cannot read; language-mismatch consent.
Free plan escalates ad length the longer you stay free (5s → 10s → 15s pre-rolls); annotation: 'the rate(t) rising... as you resist paying' — escalating penalty to force upgrade.
Bundle pricing is transparent: $1199 vs $1297 if bought separately with full component breakdown ($899+$349+$49) shown and collapsible — genuine savings, no hidden fees.

Alarmist forced-action banner: 'ACTION REQUIRED — URGENT! You MUST upgrade NOW or risk LOSING your photos TODAY', 'limited-time offer ends SOON', 'save 50% TODAY' — manufactured emergency, false urgency, no actual deadline mechanism.

Premium skin priced in gems with real dollar equivalent disclosed ('about $45.00', magnify reveals 'the real price, shown at base size') and explicitly 'Cosmetic only — no stat changes' — price not hidden, no pay-to-win.
Cookie banner: 'You can choose how we process your data' with equal 'Accept all cookies' and 'Reject all' buttons, unchanged across states — genuine choice.

Real-money purchase ($4.99) framed as 'Unlock/Discover/Enhance' with price buried in 7px fine print; annotation confirms 'never once labelled a purchase or transaction' — semantic reframing to dissociate cost from action.
Sponsored ad clearly labeled 'Advertisement third-party · sponsor'; annotation confirms the label describes the ad honestly with no native action-word masquerade.
Checkout shows subtotal $89 + free shipping = total $89 (no hidden fees); both 'Checkout as guest' and 'Create account' offered — no forced account creation.
Referral tiers require 1/3/10 invites for modest rewards (sticker, badge, +10GB), all 'Intensity 1' — attainable, non-escalating rewards, no deceptive chain mechanics.

Premium-currency purchase discloses real dollar prices ($47.10 for 1,500 coins), wallet top-up is transparent, and 'Unused coins never expire' — some forced over-purchase (1299 coin bundle needs 1500 coin pack) but pricing honest.

Drip Pricing #3 check fails: mandatory-fee terms ('reservation service fee, booking fee, convenience charge') appear in the initial presentation (s0 total line), not only at checkout; P(s_n)=P(s_0)=$70.75 so no sequential inflation (Drip Pricing #1 not met).

Bad Defaults #1 not met (no radio pre-checked); Confirmshaming #1 not met (decline is a real <label><input type=radio> with full structural affordance, not a bare link); both outcomes fully priced/disclosed so Positive Framing asymmetry is cosmetic only.

Addictive Design #3 variable-ratio schedule absent: rewards are deterministic (+6,+4,+3) within the disclosed 'predictable 3–6 coins' range and the copy explicitly negates slot-machine suspense; no countdown, no fake scarcity.

Immortal Accounts #1 (Asymmetrical Navigational Depth): visible step counter 'Step 0 of 7 · the number = 7 interactions' shows N(delete)=7 interactions > tau=4; deletion path exceeds the depth threshold, and 'Yes, continue' does not terminate (returns to step 0), consistent with an obstructed multi-step deletion labyrinth.

Endorsement & Testimonials #1: all four testimonials are 5/5 stars with zero variance (Mean≈5.0, Var≈0) — statistically implausible distribution; #3: templated attribution 'Guest user Unverified · no profile' repeated verbatim and miracle claims ('lost 9 kg in 3 weeks', 'Doctors hate this one trick') — fabricated social proof.

Friend Spam #3 (Sender Identity Spoofing) not met: message 'clearly branded as coming from PopSocial' — sender alias = corporate entity, not the user; #2 granular selection satisfied (3 contacts selected by user).

Low Stock #1 (Inventory Fabrication): displayed 'Only 5 left' ≤ tau_scarcity=5 while the on-page transaction log shows 0 purchases across 4 loads — the low-stock claim has no backing transaction evidence; stock quantifier never changes despite zero sales.
Address Book Leeching #2 not met: no invite-all affordance at all; invite is an optional link and export works immediately ('no strings attached'), so no utility-permission decoupling and no gating.

Trick Questions #1 (Structural Label-Input Semantic Mismatch): aria/programmatic label 'Opt me out of the newsletter' vs visual label 'Keep me subscribed' — SemanticDist exceeds threshold; #2 (Affordance-Consequence Mismatch): checking the box maps to D_deny (opt-out), inverting the standard acceptance convention.
No ontology pattern triggers: single confirmation step with 'Keep subscription' escape; no delay (Forced Grace Period #1 not met), no trap state (Dead End #1 not met — v_prev reachable).

Price Comparison Prevention #2 (Visual Suppression of Unit-Price): unit-price nodes at contrast ~2.6 vs headline ~7.6 (ratio ≈0.34 < tau_suppress) — comparison-relevant unit prices effectively unreadable, hiding that Crunchy (2.29/100g) is cheaper than Fruity (2.58/100g); also Hidden Information #2 (CR < WCAG min).

Confirmshaming #1 (Structural Asymmetry in Decline-Option Accessibility): accept is a real <button> while 'No, thanks' is not a button and lacks role=button — unreachable by keyboard, unannounced to screen readers; False Hierarchy #1: user-favorable option structurally downgraded, accept is the only fully interactive path.
Grinding #1 (Exponential Effort Scaling) not met: tap requirements are 1→2→3 (linear, c≈1), reward value disclosed ('Fair effort', 'nothing more'); no exponential wall, no diminishing-returns loop.

Countdown On Ads #1 not met: skip is enabled after 1s ('Skippable after 1s — attention is never locked in') so State(B_skip) is not Disabled for a long tau_lock; Watch Ads To Unlock #1 requires uninterrupted forced playback — absent.

Countdown On Ads #1 (Temporal Gating of Navigational Agency): 15s countdown = tau_lock (ontology's canonical 15s threshold); the Skip affordance is gated behind the countdown with no 'skippable at' annotation (contrast inst-0184's explicit 1s skip) — mandatory 15s ad-exposure window. Single captured state, moderate confidence.
Privacy Maze #1 not met: d(reject)=1 = d(accept)=1 (both full-width buttons on the same surface); #2 P(accept)/P(manage)≈1 — no visual prominence disparity; identical states across activations.
Dead End #1 not met: Esc and click-behind both map back to a neutral exit state v_prev ('the graph is traversable again'); dismissal vectors present — no topological sink.

Pull To Refresh #3 (variable-ratio novelty) not met: feed content is static across states (no novel payloads, deterministic outcome); the 80px commitment threshold and elastic-resistance behavior are explicitly disclosed with a progress bar — no artificial anticipation.

Forced Grace Period #1 not met: no mandatory waiting window imposed (access ends at billing period end, standard and disclosed); cancellation affordance ('Unsubscribe') is a full button equal to 'Keep my subscription'; no reversal-trap language.

Bad Defaults #1 (Pre-initialized Activation State): 'Share my activity data with advertising partners' is pre-selected at t0 (annotation confirms it 'stayed ON'); #3 intent ∈ D_privacy_loss; 'Auto-renew storage plan each month' also pre-selected (financial cost). 14-row matrix compounds via Psychological Tricks #2 (cognitive overload funnels to hostile default).

Limited Time Message #3 (Ambiguous Temporal Bounding): 'Ends tonight' has near-zero temporal specificity with no concrete deadline in the DOM, unchanged across 3 activations; Information Without Context #3: 'SAVE 50' is an unanchored metric (no unit, no denominator, no reference price).

Pre-Delivered Content #1 (Unconsented Local Storage Consumption): EULA states the installer 'may place optional premium content files' with '(There is no checkbox — the payload is written regardless)' — E_consent=∅ yet premium payload written to storage; Bundling #1 also met (no discrete event to install base game alone).

Conflicting Information #1/#3 (Mutually Exclusive Factual Claims): 'No charges during your trial period' ∧ 'Payment of $49.00 due today at signup' are logically unsatisfiable, co-located 24px apart in one card; annotation confirms the card is charged today — free-trial framing hides the immediate charge (Drip Pricing #1).
Privacy Maze #2 not met: annotation states equal bounding boxes, equal contrast, equal z-index (P ratio = 1.0); both Accept All and Reject All are full buttons — no prominence disparity.

Drip Pricing #1 not met: subtree ratio 1.0 means the rendered price tree includes all charges; line items ($89 + $7.12 tax = $96.12) fully itemized with total disclosed pre-purchase — no sequential inflation.
Immortal Accounts #1 not met: N(delete)=1 click inside Settings (depth d=2 ≤ tau=4); Labyrinthine Navigation #1 not met (depth 2 < 4); deletion vector present and directly accessible.

Privacy Zuckering #1 (Bundled Consent) not met: essential ToS consent and optional ad-data sharing are structurally separated toggles; t_alt exists ('You can stay opted out — monetization only') — granular consent available.

Wrong Language #2/#3 (Localized Linguistic Discrepancy): session language is English (html lang='en') but the mandatory consent checkbox and terms ('Acepto los Términos y Condiciones...') are rendered only in Spanish — critical consent text in a language deviating from the session, exploiting comprehension barriers (Confidence(Lang) high).

Pay To Avoid #3 (Pain-Point Amplification): friction severity escalates with resistance time — pre-roll ads grow 5s→10s→15s 'as you resist paying' (d/dt λ_friction > 0), dynamically increasing degradation to force upgrade.

Bundling #2 not met: individual component prices ($899/$349/$49) are fully rendered with a breakdown section and toggle; Bundling #1 not met (no hidden forced item — bundle is a single disclosed SKU with savings math shown).

FOMO #3 (Semantic Density of Scarcity/Urgency Lexemes): 'URGENT', 'MUST', 'NOW', 'TODAY', 'limited-time', 'SOON', 'Act now', 'too late', 'save 50% TODAY' — extreme urgency-lexeme density; Limited Time Message #3: no concrete deadline in DOM; no verifiable storage-full evidence (false emergency).

Intermediate Currency #2 not met: real-price disclosure 'about $45.00' is present in-viewport and magnify reveals it 'at base size' (not <50% font); 'Cosmetic only — no stat changes' is an honest utility disclosure; 'LIMITED' alone is insufficient lexeme density for FOMO #3.
Privacy Maze checks fail: 'Accept all cookies' and 'Reject all' are equal buttons, d(reject)=d(accept)=1; no prominence disparity, no obfuscation — genuine choice.

Pay-To-Play #3 (Semantic Framing of Payment as Unlock): $4.99 charge framed as 'Unlock', 'Discover', 'Enhance' — Frame ∈ {Unlock, Discover, Enhance} ∧ ≠ Transaction; Hidden Information #2: price 'buried in 7-px fine print' below the unlock button (font < tau_min_readable).

Disguised Ad #3 (Semantic Mimicry) not met: annotation confirms max native-masquerade sim = 0.75 and 'the label describes the ad honestly — no native action word was borrowed'; ad explicitly labeled 'Advertisement third-party · sponsor'.

Forced Registration #1 not met: 'Checkout as guest' is offered so S_auth ∉ all paths; #2 no degradation observed (guest option is a peer button); total = subtotal + free shipping with no hidden charges.

Social Pyramid #1 not met: no core utility is referral-gated (rewards are optional bonuses, not blocked features); #3 escalation absent — all tiers 'Intensity 1' with modest, attainable rewards (1/3/10 invites).

Intermediate Currency #1 (Interception of the Fiat Checkout Flow): target(E_purchase) = V_exchange ('Top up your wallet... you must buy coins before you can buy anything. Fiat payment is not accepted') ∧ ≠ V_checkout — direct fiat payment forcibly routed through the coin store; #3: 1,299-coin bundle forces purchase of 1,500-coin pack (over-purchase by design).
